tools.name: get_batch_job_status
tools.description: Get the status of a batch job (e.g. machine translation) by its ID. Use to poll for completion.

tools.name: machine_translate
tools.description: Start machine translation for specified keys into target languages. Returns a batch job ID — use get_batch_job_status to poll for completion.

tools.name: store_big_meta
tools.description: Store key relationships so Tolgee can use translations of related keys as context during machine translation, producing more consistent results. Keys that appear near each other in source code (e.g. on the same page or component) should be stored as related.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List branches in a Tolgee project. Returns up to 100 results per page. Only available for projects with branching enabled (enterprise feature).

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a Tolgee project by forking from an existing branch. Only available for projects with branching enabled (enterprise feature).

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Delete a branch from a Tolgee project. IMPORTANT: This is a destructive operation. The AI assistant should always confirm with the user before calling this tool.

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: List translation keys in a Tolgee project. Returns up to 100 keys per page. Use search_keys to find specific keys by name or translation text.

tools.name: search_keys
tools.description: Search for translation keys in a Tolgee project by name or translation text. Returns up to 50 matching keys per page. Note: namespace and tags filtering is not yet supported — filter results client-side if needed.

tools.name: create_keys
tools.description: Create translation keys in a Tolgee project with optional translations and tags. Keys that already exist are silently skipped — their translations and tags are not updated. Use update_key and set_translation to modify existing keys.

tools.name: get_key
tools.description: Get a translation key's metadata (name, namespace, description) by its name. To get the key's translations, use get_translations.

tools.name: update_key
tools.description: Update an existing translation key's name, namespace, or description

tools.name: delete_keys
tools.description: Delete translation keys from a Tolgee project. IMPORTANT: This is a destructive operation. The AI assistant should always confirm with the user before calling this tool.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List all languages configured for a Tolgee project. Returns up to 1000 results per page.

tools.name: create_language
tools.description: Add a new language to a Tolgee project

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List all namespaces in a Tolgee project. Namespaces organize translation keys into logical groups (e.g. by feature, page, or module).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Tolgee projects accessible to the current user. Returns up to 100 results per page.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new Tolgee project with initial languages

tools.name: get_project_language_statistics
tools.description: Get translation status and progress for each language in a project. Returns per-language statistics including translated, reviewed, and untranslated percentages.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags used in a Tolgee project. Returns up to 1000 results per page.

tools.name: tag_keys
tools.description: Add tags to translation keys. Creates tags if they don't exist.

tools.name: get_translations
tools.description: Get translations for a specific key in a Tolgee project. Returns translations in all project languages, or only the specified languages if provided.

tools.name: set_translation
tools.description: Set or update translations for a key in one or more languages. The key must already exist — use create_keys to create it first.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "delete_branch" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Delete a branch from a Tolgee project. IMPORTANT: This is a destructive operation. The AI assistant should always confirm with the user before calling this tool…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "delete_branch" stacks urgency/override words (important, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
